|strategy=By [mailto:jediknight@decipher.com Justin Pakes, Jedi Knight]<ref name="decipher-strategy">https://web.archive.org/web/20040811123219/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/endor/dark/small/lieutenantgrond.html</ref>

Some have argued that this Imperials last name has been misspelt. Take out the the "r" and the "n" and your closer to his true capabilities in an [[Endor (Dark){{!}}Endor]] Booster Draft.

For one, he's a scout. Thus [[Pitiful Little Band]] can be used with him. He's power 2 and ability 2 for only 2 Force, and with [[Imperial Arrest Order]] on table he's forfeit 5!

But there's more! He can drive a [[Speeder Bike (Dark){{!}}Speeder Bike]], as well as fly a starship. This makes him *invaluable* in a Booster Draft with your Lambda Class Shuttles. And then there's +2 attrition for your Biker Scout / Trooper pairs. That's just icing on an already sweet cake!

Not bad for a guy who looks like he's just standing around waiting for his coffee break!

Combos: Deploy 6 for 6 power and a destiny draw in space. The [[Endor (Dark){{!}}Endor]] system is drain 2 for you! If you get in any trouble, they can land for free anyhow.

You ready for this? Deploy 7 (Wallen for free in your battle) for power 10 and (against opponents scout) two battle destiny draws with attrition + 4 and battle destiny + 2. All your guys are forfeit 5. If that's not enough, Elsek can be forfeited to cancel all attrition and battle damage anyhow. Rebels beware!
